lede: Mountain Village Council meets Thursday to vote on a resolution setting an appreciation cap for deed-restricted units — the kind of fine print that determines whether affordable housing actually stays affordable — and that alone makes this a week worth paying attention to. Telluride's HARC is also busy Tuesday with the Shandoka Lot redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd coming in for preliminary large-scale review, while P&Z gets its first formal look at the school district's employee housing proposal on the middle-high school site. It's also the first week of school for Telluride R-1 kids, and the free Oak Street Park SummerSHOW series brings Deltaphonic to the park Thursday evening.
